subTitle: Everything you want to know about working with Crestivo.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete a project?
faqs.answer: Most projects launch within days, not weeks. Select digital animations and content assets can be delivered in as little as one day. Larger projects like full websites or business blueprints typically take 3–7 days depending on scope.

faqs.question: Do I need any technical knowledge to work with Crestivo?
faqs.answer: None at all. We handle everything from start to finish — design, development, content, and delivery. You just tell us your vision and we engineer the rest.

faqs.question: How does the price match guarantee work?
faqs.answer: Simple — get a quote from anywhere, bring it to us, and we will match it, beat it, and give you an additional discount on top. No exceptions, no fine print. You get the same product and same expectations at a better price.

faqs.question: Can Crestivo work with small businesses and everyday people — not just big brands?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We built Crestivo specifically for small businesses, entrepreneurs, and everyday people who want professional-grade results without a corporate budget. Whether you need a logo, a website, a music video, or a full business blueprint — we do it all.

faqs.question: What is a business blueprint and who is it for?
faqs.answer: A business blueprint is a deep, detailed roadmap for your business idea. Give us one sentence and we turn it into a full plan — including a business description, market analysis, marketing and sales strategy, operations plan, and financial projections. It's designed for entrepreneurs, startups, and established businesses looking to scale.

faqs.question: Can everything Crestivo builds grow with my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every system we build is designed to scale with you. From QR platforms to websites to automation workflows — everything is built on modern infrastructure that grows as your business grows.

faqs.question: Do you offer support after a project is complete?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We don't just hand you a finished product and disappear. We offer ongoing support, updates, and strategy to make sure what we built continues to perform and grow with your needs.
